title: Dispatch RFU 3: Buried Possessions Ascend with the Rain
summary: A ring lost years ago is found floating above the court.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: A brass ring rose through the shower yesterday, followed by a clay marble and a small iron key. Mrs. Eliza Marr identified the ring by its repaired setting. She says she buried it beside her mother’s grave seventeen years ago. The grave is undisturbed.

Other residents have begun naming things they fear may appear. Dr. Saye asks them to record precise locations rather than memories alone. The objects hang in the cloud for several minutes before dropping, wet but unbroken, into the closed court.
